subject: The secret feature I wasn't going to reveal yet
preview_text: You get first look at what's coming. This changes how you analyze every single race. Read before we announce it.
body_paragraphs: Okay, confession time. We've been holding back one major upgrade because we wanted it perfect. But I saw the early data yesterday and nearly spilled my coffee. It's that good. And you're hearing about it before anyone else.

Remember how you have to check the weather, then the track condition, then the jockey's form on wet ground separately? What if the AI did all that cross-referencing instantly? Not just for one horse, but for the entire field, calculating how each variable compounds the others. That's the breakthrough.

Next month, we're launching 'Conditional Confidence Scores.' The AI won't just give you a prediction score. It will show you exactly how that score changes if the rain hits before post time, or if a certain jockey gets the mount. You'll see the live odds, and right beside them, our AI's adjusted probability based on real-time factors nobody else is weighing together.

Open the app now. Go to any upcoming race. Look at the confidence score. Soon, you'll be able to tap it and see the 'What If' scenarios. This is the edge we've been building toward. Try Premium for 3 days free and be the first to experience it when it drops. P.S. The first 500 Premium users to update when this launches get a permanent 20% discount. Your loyalty just paid off.
